regions.name: Norte Grande and Norte Chico
visual_identifiers: Atacama Desert — driest place on earth

state_distinguishers.Atacama_Desert_Region: Absolutely barren, no vegetation, most distinctive landscape in Chile
state_distinguishers.Coquimbo: Pisco growing region, slightly more vegetation, La Serena city

regions.route_sign_clues: Ruta 5 (Pan-American Highway) runs through. Mining company road signs distinctive.
regions.gemini_hint: Completely barren desert = Atacama region = northern Chile. Copper mine infrastructure = Antofagasta. Salt flats = Atacama salt flat region.
common_false_positives: Desert terrain — very distinctive, hard to confuse with other Chilean regions

regions.name: Central Chile

state_distinguishers.Santiago_Metro: Large urban sprawl, Andes backdrop, specific Santiago highway infrastructure
state_distinguishers.Valparaiso: Colorful hillside port city, Pacific coastal feel, very distinctive architecture
state_distinguishers.Wine_regions: Vineyard rows in valleys, winery infrastructure

regions.route_sign_clues: Ruta 5 through central Chile. Autopista del Sol, Autopista Central near Santiago.
regions.gemini_hint: Vineyard rows in Andean valley = central Chile wine country. Colorful hillside port city = Valparaiso. Large urban with Andes backdrop = Santiago.
common_false_positives: Mediterranean scrub — similar to California or Spain

regions.name: Lake District and Patagonia Chile

state_distinguishers.Lake_District: Perfect cone volcanoes, blue lakes, German/Swiss influenced architecture
state_distinguishers.Aysen: Carretera Austral — famous gravel highway, dramatic fjords and glaciers
state_distinguishers.Magallanes: Torres del Paine, Punta Arenas city, end of continent feel

regions.route_sign_clues: Carretera Austral (Route 7) through Patagonia — very distinctive mostly gravel road.
regions.gemini_hint: Perfect cone volcano + blue lake = Chilean Lake District. Carretera Austral gravel road signs = Aysen/southern Chile. Monkey puzzle (Araucaria) trees = Araucania region.
common_false_positives: Temperate rainforest — also in southern Argentina
